flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: All in ocmseserviceui: pages/Furnish/Confirmation.ts (Back button), components/Stepper.ts (steps hidden, not removed), components/form/TextInput.ts, pages/Furnish/Form/Particulars.ts, pages/Furnish/Furnish.ts. No code in the other repos.
note: Requirement is given and status is Fully paid. The Back button on the Review step calls stepper.show(2); the Stepper only hides steps (class d-none) so form values stay filled. The user changes fields then presses 'Proceed to review' again for re-validation and a new summary. The 'save the changes' step is treated the same as OCMS42.23: changes are only stored in the browser (formData + sessionStorage), with no Save button or server draft, hence Sebagian. Watch out: the Back button on step 2 (Particulars.ts:105-110) is different, it wipes all data (resetFormData) and returns to notice selection; that is not the button this story asks for.
recommendation: Claimable with the same note as OCMS42.23: changes are only stored in the browser. The Back button on step 2 wipes data and is not what the story means.

steps.step: The Review page has a Back button to return to the previous page
steps.detail: Confirmation.InitButton gives a button labelled 'Back' with variant outline-primary (Confirmation.ts:108-111), rendered next to the Submit button (Confirmation.ts:257-262).

steps.step: The Back button takes the user to the particulars page with the values already keyed in still filled
steps.detail: The Back onClick calls stepper.show(2) (Confirmation.ts:112-114), which only changes currentStep and scrolls to the top (Stepper.ts:46-49). The Stepper renders all steps and hides inactive ones with class d-none (Stepper.ts:73-82), so the particulars form components are not thrown away and keep their values. This differs from the Back on step 2, which calls resetFormData and wipes the data (Particulars.ts:105-110, Furnish.ts:224-310).

steps.step: The user edits fields and the changes are saved for submission
steps.detail: New values overwrite formData and sessionStorage through TextInput.setValue (TextInput.ts:141-142). There is no Save button or server draft; the DB is only written on Submit (FurnishSubmissionController.java:66). Data is wiped on a new login (Furnish.ts:126-129). Same fact as the 'save' step in OCMS42.23, so the same fit.

steps.step: After 'Proceed to review' is pressed again, the data is re-validated and the summary shows the amended data
steps.detail: Proceed to review runs the same validation as the first time (Particulars.ts:114-150), calls onUpdate, which replaces summary.formData with a new copy and re-initialises the HD, owner/company and document parts (Furnish.ts:158-168). The formData change triggers Summary.updated to re-render (Summary.ts:54-73).
